id.description: The unique numerical identifier of the product.

title.description: The title or display name of the product.

body_html.description: The HTML description and details for the product.

vendor.description: The manufacturer or supplier associated with the product.

product_type.description: The category or merchandise type assigned to the product.

created_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the product was originally created.

handle.description: The unique URL-friendly slug derived from the product title.

updated_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the product was last modified.

published_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the product was made visible, or null if unpublished.

template_suffix.description: The custom Liquid template name used to render the product page, or null for the default.

published_scope.description: The channels or sales scope across which the product is published.

tags.description: A comma-separated string of search and classification tags attached to the product.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the product, such as active, draft, or archived.

admin_graphql_api_id.description: The globally unique identifier used to reference this product in the GraphQL Admin API.

items.description: A single product variant including pricing, inventory, and option combinations.

variants.description: The list of variants available for this product.

items.description: A specific option definition such as size or color.

options.description: The customizable option names and available values defined for the product.

items.description: An image resource detailing source URL, dimensions, and display position.

images.description: The collection of media images associated with the product.

image.description: The featured or primary image for the product, or null if none exists.

product.description: The product object after being updated.

description: Response body containing the updated product details.
